meta.title: Sign-up with a 6-char password and no phone logs in and returns to Profile
meta.requirement: AC3 — success logs in and returns to where it started
precondition: Guest; sign-up started from the Profile tab
steps: Profile → Create free account → check: auth.signup
Fill a free username, the 6-char password, no phone, tick terms, submit
Log in again through the API with the same credentials
expected: Back on the Profile tab signed in: profile.account with profile.username = the new username — UI tree + screenshot
API log-in with the same username in other case and the 6-char password → 200 — API response

done: free username qa_su6_4866; password = 6-char run password
